    // The natural total order on typed indices: compare the raw positions. This
    // is reflexive, antisymmetric and transitive because Integer's order is, and
    // it agrees with equality because Value is the only field. The "none"
    // sentinel (-1) sorts below every present position, which is the conventional
    // reading. Discharges the IOrderable obligation for every IIndex implementor;
    // IComparable.Compare then follows from Core's Compare(IOrderable).
    LessThanOrEquals(a: IIndex, b: IIndex): Boolean
        => a.Value <= b.Value;
